title: Consolidate scoring logic into MemoryStateMachine as single authority
description: P2 — MemoryMaintenanceTasks.DeprecateObsoleteRecords duplicates deprecation logic inline instead of calling _stateMachine.Evaluate(). MemoryMaintenanceTasks.PromoteStableRecords uses completely different criteria (30-day age + >=2 references + confidence >= 0.7) to promote Working→Core, bypassing the state machine entirely. Two competing promotion/deprecation pathways will inevitably drift. Fix: refactor maintenance tasks to use MemoryStateMachine.Evaluate as the single authority for all status transitions. Found in 10-agent codebase audit 2026-07-10 (P1-006).
